answer: Require every agent to lock a bond in a shared vault and bind it to one physical attestation, such as a sensor on a jetty whose signed plume readings give that site a unique footprint. The protocol grants one identity per footprint and slashes the bond when two identities claim the same one. A Sybil attacker therefore needs a fresh bond and a separate corrupted sensor for every fake agent; a duplicated attestation burns the whole stake. Cost grows linearly with the number of identities, so buying extra votes quickly exceeds anything those votes can earn.
